# Repository specialist workflow

Follow the specialist routing and shared invariants in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
Before domain modelling, design, implementation or review, load the matching
`homeplanner-*` skill from `.github/skills` and its relevant source references.
For multi-domain changes, use the relevant specialists together rather than
treating a generic coding answer as physical or regulatory validation.

Preserve the current edited project, stable identities, nullable inputs and
Undo/persistence behavior. Use the active Room Planner geometry for studies,
and distinguish geometric/heuristic results from measured, validated, engineered
or approved outcomes.
